H3117.d: day, time, year; day (as opposed to night); day (24 hour period); days, lifetime (pl.); time, period (general); year; temporal references
s: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second «day».
And Jacob said, Sell me this «day» thy birthright.
So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may «daily» perform my vows.
And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for «ever».
Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from «year» to year.

H3190.d: to be good, be pleasing, be well, be glad
s: And the saying pleased me «well»: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
And the thing was «good» in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
There be three things which «go» «well», yea, four are comely in going:

H3106.d: A man living at the time before the Flood, only mentioned at Gen.4.21
s: And his brother’s name was «Jubal»: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the «dove» out of the ark;
And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young «pigeons», such as he can get;
And I said, Oh that I had wings «like» a «dove»! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

H3176.d: to wait, hope, expect; (Niphal) to wait; (Hiphil) to wait, tarry, wait for, hope for
s: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that «hope» in the LORD.
Unto me men gave ear, and «waited», and kept silence at my counsel.
And he drank of the «wine», and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better «than» «wine».

H3120.d: § Javan = "Ionia" or "Greece"; Greece, Ionia, Ionians; location of descendants of Javan
s: And the rough goat is the king of «Grecia»: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
And the sons of «Javan»; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

H3103.d: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.33;; the last in order of the sons of Joktan, a descendant of Shem; one of the kings of Edom; the king of Madon, located in northern Canaan, and one of the kings who opposed Joshua during the conquest and who were routed at Meron …
s: And Bela died, and «Jobab» the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
And Ophir, and Havilah, and «Jobab»: all these were the sons of Joktan.
And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to «Jobab» king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
And he begat of Hodesh his wife, «Jobab», and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and «Jobab», the sons of Elpaal;
Thou shalt not plow with an ox and an ass «together».
There the prisoners rest «together»; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.

H3198.d: to prove, decide, judge, rebuke, reprove, correct, be right; (Hophal) to be chastened; (Niphal) to reason, reason together; (Hithp) to argue
s: Will he «reprove» thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
O LORD, «rebuke» me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath «appointed» out for my master’s son.

H3173.d: adj; only, only one, solitary, one; only, unique, one; solitary; (TWOT) only begotten son; one
s: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine «only» «son»:

H3195.d: A man of the Arabs living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.25.15;; a son of Ishmael whose descendants warred with Israel east of the Jordan; also called 'Ituraea'
s: Hadar, and Tema, «Jetur», Naphish, and Kedemah:
And they made war with the Hagarites, with «Jetur», and Nephish, and Nodab.

H3130.d: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.30.24;; the eldest son of Jacob by Rachel; father of Igal, who represented the tribe of Issachar among the spies; a son of Asaph; a man who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; a priest of the family of Shebaniah in the time of Nehemiah
s: And she called his name «Joseph»; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.
Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to «Joseph»: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:
Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of «Joseph».
And it came to pass, «whensoever» the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

H3199.d: A man of the tribe of Simeon living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.10
s: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, «Jachin».

H3102.d: A man of the tribe of Issachar living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.13

H3177.d: A man of the tribe of Zebulun living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.14
s: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and «Jahleel».

H3183.d: A man of the tribe of Naphtali living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.24
s: And the sons of Naphtali; «Jahzeel», and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

H3161.d: to join, unite, be joined, be united; (Qal) to be united; (Piel) to unite
s: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou «united»: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

H3115.d: A woman of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.20
s: And Amram took him «Jochebed» his father’s sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.

H3119.d: adv; by day, in the daytime; daytime
s: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by «day», when they went out of the camp.
They meet with darkness in the «daytime», and grope in the noonday as in the night.
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart «daily»? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

H3104.d: ram, ram's horn, trumpet, cornet; ram (only in combination); jubilee year (marked by the blowing of cornets) (meton)
s: In the year of this «jubile» ye shall return every man unto his possession.
And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of «rams»’ «horns»: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

H3178.d: Someone descended from Jahleel who was a man of the tribe of Zebulun living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.14
s: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the «Jahleelites».

H3184.d: Someone descended from Jahzeel who was a man of the tribe of Naphtali living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.24
s: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the «Jahzeelites»: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in «Jotbathah».

H3138.d: early rain, autumn shower; rain which falls in Palestine from late October until early December
s: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first «rain» and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.

H3180.d: roebuck; a kind of deer, reddish in colour; perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning unknown
s: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow «deer», and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.
And their border was «toward» «Jezreel», and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of «Jezreel».

And Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of «Jezreel», and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.
And these were of the father of Etam; «Jezreel», and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:

H3101.d: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.11.2;; son of king Ahaziah and the 8th king of Judah; son of king Jehoahaz and the 12th king of the northern kingdom of Israel; father of Gideon; a son of king Ahab; a descendant of Shelah the son of Judah …
s: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, «Joash» his son,
In the second year of «Joash» son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.
And Gideon the son of «Joash» returned from battle before the sun was up,
And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to «Joash» the king’s son;
And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and «Joash», and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.

H3147.d: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.15.5;; son of king Uzziah of Judah by Jerushah; king of Judah for 16 years and contemporary with Isaiah and king Pekah of Israel; son of Jahdai and a descendant of Caleb and Judah …
s: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, «Jotham» his son,
And «Jotham» ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and «Jotham», and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

H3100.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.8.2;; son of Pethuel and the 2nd of the 12 minor prophets with a book by his name; probably prophesied in the time of king Uzziah of Judah; eldest son of Samuel the prophet and father of Heman the singer; a Simeonite chief …
s: Now the name of his firstborn was «Joel»; and the name of his second, Abiah: they were judges in Beer-sheba.
Of the sons of Gershom; «Joel» the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and «Joel», three.
And «Joel», and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
The sons of «Joel»; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

H3129.d: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.13.2;; a son of king Saul and a friend of David; a son of the high priest Abiathar and the last descendant of Eli of whom we hear; one of David's mighty warriors …
s: And Saul said, Cast lots between me and «Jonathan» my son. And Jonathan was taken.
And «Jonathan» answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
And the sons of «Jonathan»; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, «Jonathan» the son of Shage the Hararite,
Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of «Jonathan», and with him fifty males.

H3148.d: superiority, advantage, excess; excess, better; besides, moreover, more
s: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God; and the «rest» we have utterly destroyed.
And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the «Jezreelite» had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the «Jezreelitess»;

H3141.d: A king of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.1.17;; son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and himself king of Judah for 8 years; his wife was the wicked Athaliah who was probably the instigator for his returning the nation of Judah to the worship of Baal …
s: And in the eleventh year of «Joram» the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.
«Joram» his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

Then Toi sent «Joram» his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And «Joram» brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and «Joram» his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

H3122.d: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.13.3;; a son of Rechab, chief of the Rechabites, in the time of Jehu and Ahab; a nephew of David
s: And «Jonadab» said unto the king, Behold, the king’s sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.
But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that «Jonadab» our father commanded us.
And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and «barefoot» three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;

H3107.d: A man of the Ammonites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.12.22;; a Korhite Levite, 2nd son of Obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David; one of David's mighty warriors; another of David's mighty warriors; four other priests or Levites
s: For «Jozachar» the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and «Jozabad», and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and «Jozabad», and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.

And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and «Jozabad», and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and «Jozabad», chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.

H3124.d: A prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.14.25
s: Now the word of the LORD came unto «Jonah» the son of Amittai, saying,
Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of «Jotbah».

H3110.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.25.23;; a priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim who returned with Zerubbabel; a Jewish captain after the fall of Jerusalem; the eldest son of king Josiah; a post-exilic prince of the line of David; father of Azariah, priest in Solomon's time …
s: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from «Johanan» with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.
And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat «Johanan»,
The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of «Johanan» the son of Eliashib.
And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn «Johanan», the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and «Johanan», and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.

H3142.d: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.3.20
s: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, «Jushab»-hesed, five.

H3189.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.20;; son of Reaiah and grandson of Shobal of the tribe of Judah; a son of Libni and grandson of Gershom and great grandson of Levi; a Gershonite Levite; the eldest son of Shimei and the grandson of Laadan …
s: Of Gershom; Libni his son, «Jahath» his son, Zimmah his son,
And the sons of Shimei were, «Jahath», Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat «Jahath»; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; «Jahath».

And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were «Jahath» and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.

H3137.d: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.22
s: And «Jokim», and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.

H3187.d: (Hithpael) to reckon genealogically, enrol on a genealogy, enrol, be enrolled
s: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their «genealogy».

H3144.d: A man of the tribe of Simeon(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.34
s: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and «Joshah» the son of Amaziah,

H3143.d: A man of the tribe of Simeon(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.35
s: And Joel, and Jehu the son of «Josibiah», the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

H3140.d: A man of the tribe of Gad  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.13
s: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and «Jorai», and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

H3163.d: A man of the tribe of Gad  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.14
s: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of «Jahdo», the son of Buz;

H3164.d: A man of the tribe of Manasseh  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.24
s: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and «Jahdiel», mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.

H3181.d: A man of the tribe of Issachar living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.2
s: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and «Jahmai», and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father’s house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

H3156.d: A man of the tribe of Issachar living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.7.3;; a chieftain of Issachar; a Levite and leader of the chorus at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah
s: And the sons of Uzzi; «Izrahiah»: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.

H3135.d: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.8;; a Benjamite, son of Becher; one of the officers in David's court
s: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and «Joash», and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was «Joash»:

H3185.d: A man of the tribe of Naphtali living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.24
s: The sons of Naphtali; «Jahziel», and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

H3160.d: A man of the tribe of Asher living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.34
s: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, «Jehubbah», and Aram.

H3109.d: A man of the tribe of Benjamin  living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.16;; one of the sons of Beriah the Benjamite; the Tizite, one of David's mighty warriors
s: And Michael, and Ispah, and «Joha», the sons of Beriah;
Jediael the son of Shimri, and «Joha» his brother, the Tizite,

H3152.d: A man of the tribe of Benjamin  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.18

H3170.d: A man of the tribe of Levi  living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at 1Ch.9.12
s: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of «Jahzerah», the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

H3146.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.43; one of David's mighty warriors; a priest and trumpeter in the time of David
s: Hanan the son of Maachah, and «Joshaphat» the Mithnite,

H3145.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.46
s: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and «Joshaviah», the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

H3149.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.3
s: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and «Jeziel», and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,

H3134.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.6
s: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and «Joezer», and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

H3132.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.7
s: And «Joelah», and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

H3171.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18; a Levite and one of the chief musicians in the time of David; a Gershonite Levite who had charge of the treasures in the time of David; son of Hachmoni and an officer of David and tutor of David's sons …
s: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and «Jehiel», and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
The sons of Laadan; the chief was «Jehiel», and Zetham, and Joel, three.
Also Jonathan David’s uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and «Jehiel» the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons:
And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and «Jehiel», and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
And of the sons of Heman; «Jehiel», and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.

H3174.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18; also called Jehiah at 1Ch.15.24
s: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and «Jehiah» were doorkeepers for the ark.

H3166.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.23.19;; a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag; a priest in the reign of David who helped move the ark; a Kohathite Levite, 3rd son of Hebron …
s: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, «Jahaziel» the third, Jekameam the fourth.
Benaiah also and «Jahaziel» the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
Then upon «Jahaziel» the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;
Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of «Jahaziel», and with him three hundred males.

H3168.d: A prophet living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezk.1.3;; son of Buzi and a priest and prophet; author of the book by his name; taken captive with Jehoiachin and exiled in Babylon where he prophesied for the next 22 years; a priest in charge of the 20th course in the time of David
s: Thus «Ezekiel» is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to «Jehezekel»,

H3165.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.24.20;; a Levite in the time of David; a Meronothite, officer of David in charge of the she-asses
s: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; «Jehdeiah».
Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was «Jehdeiah» the Meronothite:

H3172.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.23.8
s: The sons of «Jehieli»; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.

H3155.d: Someone descended from Zerah who was a man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.38.30
s: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the «Izrahite»: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

H3151.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.27.31
s: And over the flocks was «Jaziz» the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David’s.

H3169.d: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.16.20;; son of king Ahazby Abi or Abijah and the 12th king of Judah; his reign was characterised by his godly conduct; reigned for 29 years; head of a family of returning exiles in the time of Nehemiah …
s: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and «Hezekiah», kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
The children of Ater of «Hezekiah», ninety and eight.
Both to the «genealogy» of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;

H3139.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.18; also called Hariph at Neh.7.24
s: The children of «Jorah», an hundred and twelve.

H3136.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.14
s: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of «Jozadak», and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of «Jozadak», and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.
And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of «Jozadak», and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.

H3118.d: day; day always refers to a twenty-four hour period when the word is modified by a definite or cardinal number
s: Until the Ancient of «days» came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.
And this house was finished on the third «day» of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

H3191.d: (P'al) to be good, do good, be pleasing
s: And whatsoever shall seem «good» to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.

H3131.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.8.10
s: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of «Josiphiah», and with him an hundred and threescore males.

H3114.d: A man of the tribe of Levi  living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.10;; the head of the 1st of the 24 courses of priests in David's time; a teacher in the time of Ezra; a Judaite in the time of Nehemiah
s: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of «Joiarib», Jachin.

Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for «Joiarib», and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of «Joiarib», the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

H3167.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.15

H3150.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.25

H3111.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Neh.12.10;; son of Paseah, who assisted to repair the old gate of Jerusalem; son of the high priest Eliashib in the time of Nehemiah
s: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat «Joiada»,

Moreover the old gate repaired «Jehoiada» the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

H3133.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.11.7
s: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of «Joed», the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.

H3113.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Neh.12.10
s: And Jeshua begat «Joiakim», Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,
He is green before the sun, and his branch «shooteth» forth in his garden.
I sink in deep «mire», where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

H3128.d: § Jonath-elem-recho-kim = "the silent dove of far-off places"; meaning uncertain; probably name of melody; only used in title of Ps 56:1

s: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that «spreadeth» out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

H3116.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at Jer.37.3
s: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and «Jucal» the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchiah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,

H3153.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.25.23
s: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and «Jezaniah» the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,
It is good that a man should both hope and quietly «wait» for the salvation of the LORD.

H3112.d: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.24.6
s: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king «Jehoiachin»’s captivity,
They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth «sweat».

H3125.d: Someone from Greece, founded by Java who was a man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.2
